workflows.heading: Cross-Harness Workflows
workflows.intro: Combine any harnesses and models in Zeron without harness lock-in. Captain Deck spawns each stage, tracks live turns, and handles automatic handoffs.
workflows.preset_build_review_desc: One harness builds the task; when it finishes, a different harness automatically reviews the result read-only.
workflows.preset_fanout_desc: Spin up parallel workers across subtasks (one per line) on any harness and report back to one Captain.
workflows.preset_compare_desc: Run the same prompt side-by-side on two different harnesses or models under one Captain to compare outputs.
